description: Create a clear how-to video from your product photo or link. Choose a ready-made explainer scene, add your steps, and download a demo in minutes.
h1: How-To Video Templates for Product Demos
lead: Make the move shoppers need to learn easy to see. Add your product to an explainer scene and create a short how-to without filming.
steps_h2: How to Make a How-To Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Add the product, describe one action, and download a how-to shoppers can follow.

steps.d: Add a clear product image or link so the demo shows the item you sell.
Describe the action in one line. Make the movement and result easy for shoppers to follow.
Check the action and spoken line, then download a clip sized for your channel.

faq.q: What does a how-to video template include?
faq.a: A ready-made explainer scene gives your product a clear action, script, and video frame. Add the detail your buyers need to learn.

faq.q: How do I make a product how-to video?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste a link. Describe the action, review the spoken line, and download the finished demo.

faq.q: Can I make a how-to without filming?
faq.a: Yes. Start from a product image and choose a scene that shows the action. No camera crew or presenter booking is needed.

faq.q: Which products need a how-to video?
faq.a: Use one when a buyer needs to see a move, setup step, or result before using the product.

faq.q: Can a beginner make the demo?
faq.a: Yes. Add the product and describe the action in plain words. Edit the generated line before you post.

faq.q: Can an AI presenter explain the step?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a presenter and a voice that suit your product. Keep the action visible while the line plays.

faq.q: Can I add my own brand assets?
faq.a: Yes. Add your logo, product photo, or a clip you already have. Check that the finished demo matches what you sell.

faq.q: Where can I post the how-to?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for phone feeds, 1:1 for square posts, or 16:9 for a wide product page. Other sizes are available.

faq.q: How much does a how-to video cost?
faq.a: A 6, 10, 15, or 30 second video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. Starter is $24.50 for 200 credits; Pro is $35 for 300; Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the demo in ads or client work?
faq.a: Yes. Download the clip for paid ads, your product page, or a client handoff. Review the claims before publishing.
The explainer scene already sets the pace and frame. You can focus on the product and the action shoppers need to copy.
